title: Complete rate-limit and abuse controls
description: Verify and, where needed, fix rate limiting, bounded cache eviction, and abuse protection for auth, tools, node tests, actions, and recovery operations.
acceptanceCriteria: Sensitive routes enforce an explicit bounded rate-limit policy and return stable 429 responses
Rate-limit keys are based on trusted client identity only under the documented proxy setting
Old buckets/entries are evicted at cap and memory use is bounded
Tests cover window reset, concurrent requests, cap eviction, proxy headers, and route coverage
No rate-limit error leaks internal keys or secrets

steps.details: Add route coverage, reset, cap, concurrent, and trusted-proxy cases before production changes.

steps.description: Read `rate-limit.ts`, route call sites, cache helpers, and current tests; map keys, limits, and eviction.

steps.details: Apply only evidence-backed policy/eviction/trust-boundary corrections and preserve public route exceptions.

steps.description: Run focused tests, auth/SSRF tests, custom harness, typecheck, and lint.

technicalNotes: Rate limiting is not a substitute for auth, CSRF, or SSRF controls; keep those independent.
